question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.striker as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL AND bs.runs_scored > 0
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT pl.player_name
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player_match pm ON pm.match_id = pr.match_id AND pm.player_id = pr.player_id
JOIN player pl ON pl.player_id = pr.player_id
JOIN match m ON m.match_id = pr.match_id
WHERE (m.team_1 = pm.team_id AND m.team_1 != m.match_winner)
   OR (m.team_2 = pm.team_id AND m.team_2 != m.match_winner)
